admission.justification: Spans pyproject.toml and test_code_quality_check_scope.py, is proved by a live Pyright test, and prevents a [tool.pyright] exclude pattern from silently dropping tracked Python files from hook and wrapper file-list checks.

applicability: Explicit file-list Pyrefly invocations in .githooks/_gate.sh and quality_plan.py against root pyproject.toml.
conditions: Pyrefly runs with --force-exclude --python-interpreter-path and explicit Python file paths passed on the command line.
Every pattern in [tool.pyrefly] project-excludes remains disjoint from tracked Python files including .dagger/ so --force-exclude drops zero listed tracked files.
exclusions: Bare Pyrefly invocations with no command-line file arguments, which resolve paths through [tool.pyrefly] project-includes and disable-project-excludes-heuristics = true.
Untracked or ignored files under excluded environment, dependency, build, or cache directories.

statement: A Pyrefly command-line file list checks listed paths outside project-includes while --force-exclude still filters listed files against [tool.pyrefly] project-excludes, so the hook (.githooks/_gate.sh) and quality wrapper (quality_plan.py) file-list runs drop zero tracked Python files (including .dagger/) because [tool.pyrefly] project-excludes stays disjoint from all tracked Python paths.
title: Pyrefly CLI file lists with --force-exclude match project-excludes
